## Business Requirement

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 1 rows · columns: Change No. (text), Business Requirement (text)]
| Change No. | Business Requirement |
| 1. | In system if we have defined Buyer shipment tolerance as 105% for a Buyer and against the buyer an OC is created. Some of the quantities of OC are shipped then system show OC status as Shipped as it getting status of an OC according to below :

Total Shipped Qty = Shipped Qty + (Total Qty * Tolerance * 0.01)

If (Total Ordered Qty – Total Shipped Qty ) > 0 then status of OC will be Part Ship else Shipped. |

## User Story

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 2 rows · columns: Change # (text), Business Team (text), Expected Change (text), Impacted Output (text)]
| Change # | Business Team | Expected Change | Impacted Output |
| 1. | As a Sales user | if Buyer shipment tolerance is defined for a Buyer and against the buyer an OC is created. Only some of the quantities of OC are shipped then status of OC should be Part shipped only. | OC status should be shipped if all quantities are shipped and part shipped if partial quantities are shipped |
|  | As a Sales user | Sales>>Purchase order from buyer>>List |  |

## Business Scenario

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 1 rows · columns: Change# (text), Scenario # (text), Scenario Details (text), Expected Result (text)]
| Change# | Scenario # | Scenario Details | Expected Result |
| 1. | OC status on OC list | OC status should be shipped if all quantities are shipped and part shipped if partial quantities are shipped even if buyer shipment tolerance is defined on buyer. | The order confirmation (OC) status should be marked as "shipped" when all quantities have been shipped. Conversely, it should be categorized as "part shipped" if only partial quantities are shipped, regardless of any buyer-defined shipment tolerance. |
